Home Now Blog

Hi there. Welcome to my photo blog.

I love to travel, take photos, and write about random things.

I aso love dogs and cats. I am a proud mama of two British Shorthairs that are angels by night, devils by early morning. Back home I also have a courageous tabby and a super extroverted but insecure 1 year-old mountain dog.

I grew up in a small village filled with rice paddy fields in Taiwan, one of the most beautiful places on earth in my opinion. I have been living in Europe for more than 5 years now, and I do really miss the lush and massive mountain backdrops. I also miss being surrounded by the deep blueness of the Pacific, the heavy downpours (sounds like this) and the sounds of cicada that brings back fond memories.

For the past years I have been based in Europe, specifically Germany and the Netherlands. I am adapted to the temperate climate, but my heart is always with the subtropical 🥥🌴
